updates.content:
Title: Users may receive duplicate email messages sent to mailboxes using Exchange Online SMTP forwarding

User impact: Users may receive duplicate email messages sent to mailboxes using Exchange Online SMTP forwarding.

More info: Messages sent to mailboxes configured with Exchange Online SMTP forwarding and 'DeliverAndForward' are being delivered more than once to external recipients. This may result in duplicate tickets, updates, workflows, or notifications in downstream systems.

Current status: We're reviewing support-provided information and comparing examples of duplicated and non-duplicated messages to better understand why this behavior occurs intermittently. This is helping us determine the conditions under which duplicate message delivery can occur and identify appropriate next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and any user expecting email messages in an Exchange Online mailbox configured with SMTP forwarding is impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.
